title: 5-Axis Machining AI — Kinematics, TCPC & Simultaneous Intelligence

units.title: 16 5-Axis Machining AI domains with Claude Opus prompts
units.details: Added 16 5AXIS-AI domains: fiveaxis_kinematics (head-head/head-table/table-table), fiveaxis_tcpc (TCPC/RTCP tool center point), fiveaxis_singularity (gimbal lock avoidance), fiveaxis_lead_lag (lead/lag optimization), fiveaxis_tilt_strategy (tool axis tilting), fiveaxis_collision (collision detection), fiveaxis_gouge (gouge checking), fiveaxis_geodesic (geodesic strategies), fiveaxis_swarf (SWARF machining), fiveaxis_port (port/impeller), fiveaxis_flowline (UV machining), fiveaxis_positional (3+2 machining), fiveaxis_simultaneous (5-axis interpolation), fiveaxis_indexing (rotary positioning), fiveaxis_machine_model (machine configuration), fiveaxis_simulation (verification)

summary: Complete 5-axis machining AI intelligence with 16 domains covering machine kinematics, TCPC/RTCP, singularity avoidance, lead/lag angles, tilt strategies, collision detection, gouge checking, geodesic/SWARF/flowline strategies, positional (3+2) vs simultaneous, indexing, machine models, and simulation. Deep expertise from 10 PDFs and 35 machine configurations.
